# ForeSports — AI-readable site reference

## Company

ForeSports Private Limited is building a connected golf platform in India. ForeSports connects golfers, golf coaches, and golf facilities in one ecosystem.

Official website: https://www.foresports.in/
Contact: hello@foresports.in

## What ForeSports does

ForeSports is focused on making golf easier to discover, book, manage, and grow. The platform brings together the golf participants and businesses that currently use fragmented discovery, booking, coaching, and operational workflows.

The website currently presents three primary audiences:

### Golfers

ForeSports helps golfers discover and book golf, find coaches, access lessons and practice opportunities, and connect with golf facilities.

Official page: https://www.foresports.in/golfers

### Golf coaches

ForeSports provides a platform for golf coaches to be discovered by golfers and to support coaching workflows including bookings, payments, student management, and performance tools.

Official page: https://www.foresports.in/coaches

### Golf facilities

ForeSports helps golf facilities improve discoverability, fill tee times and practice inventory, and manage facility operations.

Official page: https://www.foresports.in/facilities
